_note: A19: the learned thinking stop (STRATA_THINK_PROBE, a linear probe on the hidden state at the thinking's check points; the dump hook is spec 16-a19-hidden-dump.json). LOSSY, opt-in, and it cannot run until the probe is TRAINED: take dumps on real agent turns (STRATA_HIDDEN_DUMP=<dir>,every=64), train with tools/pancake/thinking_probe.py (labels, probe, calibration, SPRB export), then put the weights file and threshold in the arm below (STRATA_THINK_PROBE=<weights>,<threshold>[,k=K][,min=M]; the path here is where thinking_probe.py's export is expected, not an existing file). Judged on time to success (A57 area under the curve) with success within 5 pts of the base: thinking is where the time goes (6.6% of turn time plus the tail). The close needs the soft-close grace of the presets (reasoning_budget_grace 512).
